## ☁️ AWS Cost Optimization
**Account:** `971937022656`  |  **Region:** `us-east-1`

Track underutilized EC2 instances and idle EBS volumes. Use the time picker to adjust the analysis window — wider windows surface sustained waste.

3.query: timeseries cpu=avg(cloud.aws.ec2.CPUUtilization.By.InstanceId), by:{InstanceId}, interval:1h | fieldsAdd avg_cpu=arrayAvg(cpu) | fields InstanceId, avg_cpu | sort avg_cpu asc
3.title: EC2 Average CPU per Instance — sorted lowest first

5.title: EBS Volume Idle Time (seconds/min — max 60 = 100% idle)

6.query: timeseries reads=avg(cloud.aws.ebs.VolumeReadBytes.By.VolumeId), writes=avg(cloud.aws.ebs.VolumeWriteBytes.By.VolumeId), idle=avg(cloud.aws.ebs.VolumeIdleTime.By.VolumeId), by:{VolumeId}, interval:1h | fieldsAdd avg_reads=arrayAvg(reads), avg_writes=arrayAvg(writes), idle_pct=arrayAvg(idle)/60*100 | fields VolumeId, idle_pct, avg_reads, avg_writes | sort idle_pct desc
6.title: EBS Volume Summary — Idle % and I/O

| Priority | Resource | Finding | Recommended Action | Est. Savings |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------------|---------------|
| 🔴 High | EC2 `i-041bf6822056e4e5c` | ~2.5% avg CPU | Downsize 2 tiers (e.g. m5.large → t3.small) | 50–70% compute cost |
| 🔴 High | EC2 `i-099682b0640af8cd9` | ~2.6% avg CPU | Downsize 2 tiers | 50–70% compute cost |
| 🟡 Medium | EBS `vol-07305728e7b420ccc` | ~100% idle, 122 KB/s writes | Migrate gp2 → gp3 (20% cheaper); confirm still attached and needed | ~20% storage |
| 🟡 Medium | EBS `vol-0209a60da8758773e` | ~100% idle, minimal I/O | Migrate gp2 → gp3; snapshot + delete if unused | ~20–100% storage |
| 🟡 Medium | EBS `vol-0d89eab9fb9edf722` | ~100% idle, low reads | Migrate gp2 → gp3 | ~20% storage |
| 🟡 Medium | EBS `vol-02aafd339edf2a56c` | ~100% idle, low I/O | Migrate gp2 → gp3 | ~20% storage |
| 🔵 Low | Both EC2 instances | Sustained low utilization | Buy 1-yr Convertible Reserved Instances | 30–40% vs On-Demand |

**How to use this dashboard:** Adjust the time picker to 7d or 30d to see sustained waste vs spiky workloads. Instances consistently below 10% CPU are prime right-sizing targets. EBS volumes with idle_pct near 100 are costing money while doing nothing — snapshot them and delete, or migrate volume type.
